description_en: You can this operation to obtain the list of authorized works displayed on the homepage of a specified user
description_zh: 获取指定用户在首页看板中展示的被授权的作品列表
kebab_example: aliyun quickbi-public list-shared-reports --user-id b5d8fd9348cc43270000afb604 --keyword '测试报表' --tree-type PAGE --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSharedReports

parameters.help_en: The UserID of the user to be queried in the Quick BI
parameters.help_zh: 要查询用户在Quick BI中的UserID
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: Keyword of the name of the work
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
Query the type of the work (fill in the blank to query all types). Valid values:

*   DATAPRODUCT: BI portal
*   PAGE: Dashboard
*   REPORT: workbook
parameters.help_zh:
查询作品的类型（填空查询所有类型）。取值范围 ：
- DATAPRODUCT：数据门户
- PAGE：仪表板
- REPORT：电子表格
parameters.name: tree_type

parameters.help_en:
Query the number of rows in the work list:

*   Default value: 10.
*   Maximum value: 9999
parameters.help_zh:
查询作品列表的行数：

- 默认值：10
- 最大值：9999
parameters.name: page_size
